description:
Every product that broke too soon has a story — a cost-cutting decision, a design shortcut, or a company that simply stopped caring about quality.
Warranty Void investigates the everyday household products that were built to fail, the planned obsolescence strategies behind them, and the companies that profited from things falling apart right on schedule, year after year.
Topics we cover: planned obsolescence and product design history, household product failures, consumer manufacturing shortcuts, company histories behind poorly-made household goods, product recall controversies, and consumer rights documentaries.
Deep research, original sources, and full-length documentaries on why your stuff doesn't last like it used to.
New documentaries regularly. No sponsorships. No brand deals.
